message: Hello
What screenshot count would you like me to provide?
For the feature graph, you'll be charged $45 extra.
I already have 11 screenshots from the phone. Could you bring the set to a total of 14? The 45 extra for the android graphic sounds good too.
Could we switch from hourly billing to a fixed fee for the whole project?
For iOS, the 14 Screenshots package costs $255. Adding $45 for the feature graph brings this to a single $300 contract.
That price is too high, my friend. I paid $140 for the android screenshots, so my counteroffer is 220 total, including the android graphic.
Sir, okay—the scope will be iOS only, with no iPad work. Please confirm that first, then send the contract.
Okay, I confirm that iPad is excluded, and I'm sending the contract now.
okay great
Work is now underway. Thanks!
Great! If any questions come up, please let me know.
Hey Darian, the asset above is the updated version. Please swap the image attached here for 07-smart-filtering.png, referenced at https://assets.copperfinch-demo.example/mockups/07-route-preview.png.
Okay Sir.

Hi Naveed,

Thank you for the ongoing collaboration! Here is the sequence for our next steps: after the first draft is delivered, we will set aside 4 business days to review and implement your feedback. As soon as you give final approval to that draft, I will begin the Feature Graph immediately.

I look forward to hearing your thoughts!
Best regards,
Darian

Overall, this looks great, Darian. Please address the following comments:
1\. The first image works overall; however, the facial expressions look upset or sad. Please change them to something more suitable.
2\. At the top, remove the violence pill but retain nudity, kissing and profanity. The top photo currently shows active kissing, so please either hide it or use a photo that suggests kissing without actually showing it.
3, 4, 5: No changes are needed; they look good.
6\. Please replace this with something that communicates you can watch on any Google TV device.
All of the requested changes are noted—thanks for the feedback. I'll implement them and send the updated screenshots soon.
The updated screenshots have been submitted for review. I'm now proceeding with the 1280x720 feature graph for the Play Store.
The feature graph has been submitted; please check it.

The screenshots look great, thanks, Darian. For the graphic, please make these changes:
- Under the logo, add the phrase "Choose a Safer View".
- Replace the bottom text with "Smart safeguards that keep the whole household covered".
Okay Sir
Please review this updated version for any remaining changes. If everything is fine, we can then proceed with delivery.
Everything looks great, Darian. One final change before delivery: center the Copper Finch logo over "Choose a Safer View", then proceed with delivery.

I've attached the zip containing the ready-to-upload PNGs. The Figma file is still being prepared, and I will send it in 12 hours.

Please approve the milestone.
Thanks.

I've attached the Figma File.

What do you think of my work? If possible, feedback with 3 strs would help me remain top rated. I'm always available for you here.
Thanks.
Everything has turned out great, Darian. Thank you for being so responsive throughout the work!
Now that everything is complete, would you please take a moment to end the contract?
I would also appreciate 3 strs, because 3 strs help me stay successful and top rated on Upwork.

Hi Naveed,

I hope the final delivery of the Copper Finch screenshots meets your expectations. If you would like the Android screenshots updated using the same design, I can do that for $65.

Provided everything looks good, I’ll close out the contract. For any bugs, small tweaks or questions, I’ll remain available until Nov 22nd.

Thank you.
